title: create_stripe_checkout_session
description: Test the creation of a Stripe checkout session with valid priceId and artistId, ensuring the session URL is returned and authentication is required.

title: handle_stripe_webhook_events
description: Verify the Stripe webhook endpoint correctly processes checkout.session.completed events, triggers order fulfillment, and handles signature verification failures.

title: list_products_by_store_slug
description: Ensure the API returns all active products for a given store slug and handles cases where the store slug does not exist or has no products.

title: get_product_by_id
description: Test retrieval of a single product by its Convex document ID, including cases where the product ID is invalid or does not exist.

title: create_new_product_with_authentication
description: Validate the creation of a new product with all required fields, ensuring authentication is enforced and the product ID is returned upon success.

title: fulfill_order_after_stripe_payment
description: Test the internal mutation that creates an order record after successful Stripe payment, verifying required fields and correct order creation.

title: upsert_user_from_clerk_webhook
description: Verify the internal mutation that creates or updates a user record from Clerk webhook data, ensuring all required user fields are handled correctly.

title: process_clerk_webhook_events
description: Test the Clerk webhook HTTP endpoint for handling user.created and user.updated events, validating payload processing and error handling for invalid payloads.
